description: This file defines the 'Bitmap' class providing support for simple bit maps, including methods for setting, clearing, resizing, and querying bits, as well as managing internal storage.

classes.name: disk_cache::Bitmap
classes.description: A class that manages a bitmap, allowing bit manipulation, resizing, and direct access to internal storage.

methods.name: Bitmap
methods.description: Default constructor for Bitmap.

methods.name: Bitmap(int num_bits, bool clear_bits)
methods.description: Constructs a Bitmap with specified number of bits, optionally clearing bits.

methods.name: Bitmap(uint32_t* map, int num_bits, int num_words)
methods.description: Constructs a Bitmap with external storage provided by caller.

methods.name: ~Bitmap
methods.description: Destructor for Bitmap.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the bitmap, discarding or zero-filling bits as needed.

methods.name: SetAll
methods.description: Sets all bits to true or false.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all bits in the bitmap.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific bit.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the value of a specific bit.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.description: Toggles the value of a specific bit.

methods.name: SetMapElement
methods.description: Sets an element of the internal map directly.

methods.name: GetMapElement
methods.description: Retrieves an element of the internal map.

methods.name: SetMap
methods.description: Sets the entire internal map from an external array.

methods.name: GetMap
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal map.

methods.name: SetRange
methods.description: Sets a range of bits to a specific value.

methods.name: TestRange
methods.description: Checks if any bits in a range are set to a specific value.

methods.name: FindNextBit
methods.description: Finds the next bit set to a specific value starting from an index.

methods.name: FindNextSetBitBeforeLimit
methods.description: Finds the next set bit before a limit.

methods.name: FindNextSetBit
methods.description: Finds the next set bit from an index.

methods.name: FindBits
methods.description: Counts consecutive bits set to a specific value starting from an index.

methods.name: RequiredArraySize
methods.description: Calculates the number of 32-bit words needed for a given number of bits.

methods.name: SetWordBits
methods.description: Sets a number of bits within a single word.
